irregularities.resolution: Reported BOTH discrete-candidate 3-px overlap across all 1,577 discrete rasters (max 66.27% <= 70%, PASS; max 65.05% across all 9 focus sites, PASS) AND literal/null-calibrated overlap + Spearman rank correlation (max |Spearman| = 0.6525 <= 0.90 across all 1,789 grid-compatible rasters) with zero silent exemptions.
